title: Circuit edge language
statement: The edge language of a circuit family consists of strings encoding a unary string of $n$ true symbols together with the pair of binary representations of natural numbers $i$ and $j$, for some $n,i,j$, such that there is an edge from vertex $i$ to vertex $j$ in the family’s circuit at parameter $n$.
hypotheses_covered: The string has the specified nested pair encoding
There is an edge from $i$ to $j$ in the circuit at $n$
